1043459_a6b80581.text: Orexin is a neuropeptide produced by a specific subset of neurones located in the lateral hypothalamic area

1043459_aad3fb68.text: .Mice lacking either prepro‐orexin or orexin receptor 2, as well as those in which orexin‐producing neurones (orexin neurones) are deleted, share a common phenotype: altered sleep–wake regulation and the sudden onset of muscle atonia. These symptoms are similar to the human sleep disorder narcolepsy

1043459_c1656e68.text: .the use of orexin/halorhodopsin and orexin/channelrhodopsin‐2 transgenic mice has demonstrated an important role for orexin neurones in regulating the sleep–wake cycle and state of arousal in vivo.
